Thanks again for taking the time today, Aaron and Priya — really productive call. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our side: 

- Scope: you wanted a focused follow-up on Incident Response (IR), breach notification timelines, and Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery (BCP/DR) evidence for your internal vendor review.
- Action items for Redwood: share SOC 2 Type II report (latest), provide our incident response timeline and escalation matrix, and a short BCP/DR summary with RTO/RPO where applicable.
- You mentioned FinTechCorp’s security questionnaire — happy to start that intake. If you can send the questionnaire (or a link to your vendor portal), we’ll populate the parts that are Redwood-facing and loop in Security for the detailed evidence.

Next steps: I will gather the SOC 2 artifact and an IR playbook excerpt, and coordinate with Jordan and Rachel on the BCP/DR summary. Expect a package from us by tomorrow morning PT.

If anything above is missing or incorrect, let me know and I’ll update.

Thanks,

Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap and for jumping on this quickly. A few clarifications/questions from our security and vendor risk team: 

1) SOC 2: can you confirm whether the report is Type II and the coverage period (we typically need the latest 12-month period). Do you also have any SOC 2 bridge letters or remediations to call out since the last report?

2) Incident Response / breach notification: what are Redwood’s standard detection-to-notification SLAs? In particular: 
   - Average time to acknowledge a confirmed security incident to customers?
   - Commitment on breach notification timelines (we have regulatory obligations to notify within X hours depending on the severity).

3) GDPR/HIPAA: For clarity, if we treat Redwood as a processor for any regulated data, do you have standard DPA clauses or HIPAA BAAs available (or a DPA template we can sign)?

4) Vendor questionnaire: I’ll attach our standard security questionnaire in a follow-up email (it’s our vendor portal export). Can Redwood security start the intake so we can track progress in our vendor risk system?

We’d appreciate the SOC 2 and an excerpt from your IR playbook and BCP summary to get the vendor review moving.

Best,
Aaron
Sr. Security PM, FinTechCorp
aaron.li@fintechcorp.com

Marissa — forwarding Aaron’s note here and adding internal asks.

Notes for the evidence package (what Security prefers to provide initially):
- redwood_soc2_type2_2025.pdf (full report, PII redacted where required)
- incident_response_playbook_excerpt.pdf (summary of IR roles, detection -> triage -> customer notification timelines)
- bcp_dr_summary.xlsx (high-level RTO/RPO by service, data replication zones, DR test cadence)

Specific guidance on the IR timelines to include in the response:
- Acknowledgement of suspected incident: within 2 hours of detection (internal),
- Initial customer notification for confirmed incidents: within 72 hours (standard),
- Critical/severe incidents where legal/regulatory timelines apply: escalate and provide notification in 24 hours when required by agreement/regulation — provide details per-case.

On GDPR/HIPAA/DPA: attach our standard DPA link and note that Redwood can sign a DPA; for HIPAA workloads we provide a BAA on request (requires Legal review and an exec signature).

Marissa — please send the package to Aaron and Priya and bcc security@fintechcorp.com. Rachel, can you attach the SOC 2 and the IR/BCP docs to Marissa’s outgoing? Also include a link to the secure evidence folder (Drive) and our redaction note.

-Jordan
Director, Security & Trust
